regime_context: Detector state for China A-shares shows Semiconductors leading momentum with AI Compute as close challenger, but momentum backtest IC ~0 and the absolute trend gate did not reduce drawdown historically on this market. Eligible theme breadth is narrow (36%). Past desk calls have a hit rate of 45% and directional accuracy of 35%, so the below leans are low conviction and contingent on trend persistence, not forward prediction.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics (515000.SS): Watch for possible leadership handoff if its durability_bar rises above 0.5, breadth expands beyond 0.15, and the score gap to Semiconductors shrinks to <0.1. Kill if Semiconductors re-accelerates widening the margin past 0.3.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors sits at rank #1 momentum, eligibility-true, with a trend tag and durability just at threshold. The lean is that the trend persistency model may favor continuation, but low breadth signals narrow leadership—not a robust trend. Given the historical failure of the gate, this is a cautious overweight.
theses.dissent: The gate has not worked on this market historically, and momentum's forward IC is ~0; the narrow breadth (0.045) could mean the theme is highly concentrated and vulnerable to single-stock reversals. A rotation to value could trigger rapid mean reversion.

falsifier.text: 512760.SS fails to close above its 50-day moving average for three consecutive days and its 20-day relative strength vs CSI 300 turns negative.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma is durable (trend tag, durability_bar 0.79) but shows elevated crowding (z=1.13), which the methodology treats as a sizing caution. We lean underweight—not as a call that it will fall, but that crowding risk suggests limiting exposure relative to benchmark during this check period.
theses.dissent: Crowding is coincident and has no forward basket-level timer edge; crowded themes can continue to lead in trending markets. Pharma's durable trend might persist, and underweighting could miss further upside if the theme remains strong.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ closes above its 20-day high and its 10-day relative strength vs CSI 300 turns positive, while the crowding z-score falls below 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
